args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

When two statements are uploaded concurrently or back-to-back, worker.ts lists transactions in range independently for each job before either has inserted its rows. This causes both uploads to miss overlapping days because neither finds the other's pending transactions in the database when querying the date range. Update the duplicate detection and ingestion to handle concurrent or overlapping uploads safely, or check against previously processed incoming rows / lock properly.
args.title: Handle overlapping statements uploaded together in worker deduplication

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When two statements are uploaded together, their worker jobs run concurrently or back-to-back before transactions are committed, causing `listInRange` to miss overlapping days.
